thread:
alex.sales: Quick thread for Vera (client) POC decision. Need hosting rec by tomorrow AM. Short replies pls.

sasha.se: Call notes:
- Use: sensitive claims ingestion -> redact + classify -> analyst UI
- Targets: redaction recall >= 98%, P95 latency < 300ms for 250 tokens
- Volume: 120k requests over 4 weeks, bursts up to 250 concurrent

nina.security: Requirements: EU-only residency, customer-managed keys (CMK), 12mo audit log retention, secure deletion after POC.

alex.sales: Options: Hosted (fast), Dedicated (CMK + isolation), Private (HSM/on-prem). Which fits?

cam.infra: Dedicated fits CMK and latency predictability. ETA to provision EU dedicated pool: ~48-72h. Private onboarding 6-8 weeks. Hosted can be EU but CMK limited.

pete.finance: Need token estimate to price POC. Alex/Vera, can you confirm requests * avg tokens?

vera.client: ~120k requests, ~140 tokens avg. Dedicated preferred if CMK supported and logs exportable.

qa-bot: Presales checklist: ensure fallback model path, autoscale plan, SOW rollback clause.

alex.sales: Actions: Sasha build eval + prompts (owner: sasha.se). Cam: sizing + cost (owner: cam.infra). Nina: CMK integration checklist (owner: nina.security). Pete: draft 4-week TCO Hosted vs Dedicated (owner: pete.finance). Vera: share KMS ARN + sample dataset.

sasha.se: Will prepare 300 prompt eval set and load plan.

cam.infra: /me will post sizing + autoscale policy by EOD.

nina.security: Will confirm log export path and deletion attestation.

pete.finance: Will model costs once cam posts GPU sizing.

alex.sales: Thanks all. If Dedicated is green, we present Dedicated-first with Hosted fallback to speed demo. Flag blockers here.
